metadata.title: Avelumab Monotherapy
metadata.indication: First-line maintenance treatment of locally advanced or metastatic urothelial carcinoma without progression after platinum chemotherapy.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Current NCCP source reconciled; independent clinical/pharmacy approval pending

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or the specialist authority specified in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: NCCP does not recommend dose reduction. Treatment interruption, discontinuation and an infusion-rate change are distinct actions. Restart requires documented source recovery and consultant confirmation.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding includes NCCP 00535 Version 6b. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

indications.description: First-line maintenance treatment of locally advanced or metastatic urothelial carcinoma without progression after platinum chemotherapy.
Metastatic Merkel cell carcinoma after at least one line of chemotherapy for metastatic disease.

treatment.schedule_summary: Avelumab 800 mg IV over 60 minutes on day 1 every 14 days until progression or unacceptable toxicity.

administration.note: Infuse in 250 mLNaCl 0.9% over 60 minutes using 0.2 micrometre low-protein-binding filter.

eligibility: MCC: histologically proven metastatic Merkel cell carcinoma after≥1chemotherapy line for metastatic disease.
Urothelial maintenance: histologically confirmed unresectable locallyadvanced/metastatic transitional-cell carcinoma, progression-free after platinum completed4–10weeks before initiation.
exclusions: Hypersensitivity to avelumab/excipients; organ transplant history; pregnancy; breastfeeding.
PriorPD-1/PD-L1 therapy: consult current NCCP guidance, not a blanket automatic exclusion.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Highest emetogenic active component and current NCCP classification.
supportive_care.premedication: Antihistamine plus paracetamol before the first four infusions; subsequent premedication clinician discretion if fourth infusion was completed without a reaction.
supportive_care.premedication_source: NCCP 00535 v 7 pp 6–7: suggested paracetamol 1 gPO and chlorphenamine 10 mgIV, at least 30 minutes before infusion; individual prescription/local policy required.
supportive_care.contraception: Effective contraception during treatment and for at least 1 month after the last dose.

monitoring.disease_monitoring: According to the supervising consultant treatment plan; no universal imaging cadence specified.
